name: Atlantic hurricanes
summary: No active Atlantic storms; low south of Bermuda has a 30% chance of forming
state: The National Hurricane Center showed no active systems on 3 Nov. A low a few hundred miles south of Bermuda has a 10% chance of development in 48 hours and 30% in seven days, and is expected to move east into the open Atlantic with no threat to the US mainland (ClickOrlando). The season ends on 30 Nov.
for_you: No action needed; follow the National Hurricane Center if travelling to the Caribbean.
rubric_hit: No active system; formation chance < Watch

sources.title: ClickOrlando — Tropical low could develop over the Atlantic

why: Atlantic hurricanes hit the US Gulf coast, Caribbean and Central America — and refinery and insurance markets with them.
drivers: Sea-surface temperatures, ENSO, wind shear, season timing (Jun–Nov peak Aug–Oct).

rubric.alert: Category 3+ landfall expected within 72 hours or occurring.
rubric.watch: Tropical storm or hurricane threatening land within 5 days.
